title: Operational Tooling: Convert admin utilities into composable task catalog
creator: Marcus Li
description: We will convert the most-used ad-hoc admin scripts and support playbooks into a curated, composable Task Catalog that can be invoked from the ops console and runbook runner. Goal is to reduce MTTR for first-line support, standardize telemetry, and enable safe dry-runs and RBAC gating for privileged actions. Scope: inventory of ~30 utilities, standard input/output schemas, idempotency checks, telemetry hooks, and a small SDK for wrapping existing scripts.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory created and prioritized (top 30 by frequency & risk)
10 utilities converted to Task Catalog with typed inputs and idempotency tests
Dry-run mode available for converted tasks in the staging environment
Dashboard shows task-level success/failure rates and per-task latency
RBAC and audit log entries emitted for all privileged task runs
risks: Privileged actions may require additional security sign-off or KMS integration
Converting brittle scripts could uncover hidden stateful dependencies
User resistance if UX alters existing on-call flows
